text.autoconfig.rarefishfinder.title: Rare Fish Finder Configuration
text.autoconfig.rarefishfinder.option.gl: Off: no glow. Rare fish: only rare variants glow. All tropical fish: everything glows, rares in your chosen color and commons in gray.
Fish whose variant is already in your collection stop glowing, so the glow only shows what you still need.
text.autoconfig.rarefishfinder.option.na: Shows pattern and color information above rare tropical fish.
text.autoconfig.rarefishfinder.option.sh: Renders the actual fish model and its rarity in tropical fish bucket tooltips.
text.autoconfig.rarefishfinder.option.to: Which way the fish faces in the tooltip. 65 is a three-quarter side view, 90 is straight side-on, 180 faces you.
Tilts the tooltip camera up or down in degrees.
text.autoconfig.rarefishfinder.option.ho: Hovering a tropical fish bucket marks its variant as collected. Handy for importing fish already stored in chests; turn off if only your own catches should count.
text.autoconfig.rarefishfinder.option.sh: Shows a NEW badge in the bucket tooltip when that variant is not in your collection yet.
text.autoconfig.rarefishfinder.option.gl: Outline color used for rare tropical fish.
text.autoconfig.rarefishfinder.option.hi: Hide Common Fish on Xaero's Map
Keeps common tropical fish off Xaero's minimap radar and world map, so only rare ones show.
text.autoconfig.rarefishfinder.option.on: Only Show Tropical Fish on Xaero's Map
Hides every other entity from Xaero's minimap radar and world map, leaving only tropical fish. Combine with the option above to see only the rare ones.
text.autoconfig.rarefishfinder.option.sh: Draws the fish's two colors in the corner of tropical fish bucket icons.
text.autoconfig.rarefishfinder.option.so: With ClientSort installed, sorting groups fish buckets by pattern, then colors.
text.autoconfig.rarefishfinder.option.fi: Removes the stray lines around fish fins, a vanilla bug. Needs a restart.
